title.zh: 刑事诉讼法典（查看证物）条例 2025
title.en: Criminal Procedure Code (Viewing of Exhibits) Regulations 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Criminal Procedure Code (Viewing of Exhibits) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 26 May 2025.

heading.en: Prescribed places for viewing of exhibits

text.en: 2. For the purposes of sections 166(2A)(b), 218(2A)(b) and 225C(2)(b) of the Code, the prescribed places at which a documentary exhibit or exhibit (as the case may be) mentioned in those provisions may be viewed are the premises specified in the Schedule.
